rationale: All five AREA 3 runs reach T_eff 7.5-8.4 ns, while DELAY 3/4 give 8.9-9.4 and AREA 2 gives 12.4, so pin AREA 3. Among the AREA 3 runs, the best two (7.55, 7.64) both use timing-driven placement without routability-driven placement, and both use cap213 RC. The two AREA 3 runs without timing-driven placement are the worst (8.2-8.4). Every run has zero DRC, at most 19 slew/cap pins against a bar of 295, and positive hold, so feasibility is not the bottleneck. Even the tightest allowed target (period_frac 0.45, 8.6 ns) is above the ~7.5 ns achieved, so pin it to keep target and T_eff as close as possible for the re-run stage. Util 40 matches the best run, which had zero DRC. Synthesis buffering/sizing, density, repair limits and margins stay free for local exploration.
